eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Nevada, CA; at 5:26 PM on AUG 20, 2022 Effective until 7:26 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Nevada County Sheriff's Office issuing an Evacuation ORDER for a Wildfire located at Owl Creek Road and Kodama Road affecting zone NCO-E075; All residents NORTH of Newtown Road in Zone NCO-E075 EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY. Residents SOUTH of Newtown Road remain under an Evacuation WARNING. Check Community.Zonehaven.com for updates and available shelter locations
